event_summary: 1829年、39作目の歌劇『ウィリアム・テル』を発表した37歳のロッシーニは、絶頂期に忽然と作曲活動から退いた。以後40年、名シェフのカレームと交流しながら美食家として名を馳せ、『トゥルヌドス・ロッシーニ』にその名を残した。
hook_copy: 39作のオペラを残し[G]37歳で電撃引退[/G]。余生は[G]美食家に転身[/G]。
portrait_prompt: Portrait illustration of the Italian composer Gioachino Rossini, based on the 1828 portrait by Hortense Haudebourt-Lescot: a plump, rounded youthful face with a warm, faintly witty half-smile, thick dark brown wavy hair swept back from a high forehead, prominent dark sideburns extending down the cheeks, lively dark brown eyes, a straight nose. He wears an elegant early-19th-century Romantic-era gentleman's outfit: a dark tailcoat, a high white winged shirt collar, and a voluminous white cravat tied in a soft bow at the throat, exactly as in the historical portrait, with no added gold embroidery or extra jewelry. Bust-to-shoulder composition, facing slightly to one side toward the viewer. Illustrated cinematic style, painterly rendering, not photorealistic. Background is a plain, muted solid tone (soft warm brown or olive) with no texture or vignette. No text, no letters, no watermark. The illustration fills the entire canvas edge-to-edge with no border, no frame, no vignette, no darkened edges.

middle_slides.text: 37歳のロッシーニは『セビリアの理髪師』や『ウィリアム・テル』など39作のオペラを世に送り出し、当時最も成功した作曲家だった。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style illustration, painterly, not photorealistic, of a triumphant 37-year-old Gioachino Rossini standing confidently at the center of a grand opera house stage after a premiere, same appearance as his historical portrait: plump rounded youthful face with a faintly witty smile, thick dark brown wavy hair swept back, dark sideburns, dressed in an early-19th-century dark tailcoat with a high white cravat. He faces the viewer directly, standing tall with an air of success, surrounded by soft golden stage light, ornate red velvet curtains and gilded opera boxes in the background evoking works like The Barber of Seville and William Tell. No text, no other people clearly rendered as main subjects, warm romantic color palette.

middle_slides.text: ところが『ウィリアム・テル』の初演直後、彼は忽然とオペラ創作から身を引いた。健康問題など諸説あるが、真の理由は今も謎のままだ。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style illustration, painterly, not photorealistic, of Gioachino Rossini seen entirely from behind, face not visible, walking slowly away down a dim, empty opera house corridor just after a triumphant premiere. He wears an early-19th-century dark tailcoat, his thick dark wavy hair visible from behind, his posture calm yet resolute as he exits the grand hall, faint applause light glowing behind him from the stage he is leaving. The scene feels quiet, mysterious, and reflective, with muted warm tones and long shadows. No text, no other clearly rendered people, atmosphere of a graceful farewell to a glittering world.

middle_slides.text: 以後40年、彼は料理という第二の情熱に没頭。名シェフ・カレームとパテと引き換えに一曲贈る文通を交わし、美食家として名を馳せた。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style illustration, painterly, not photorealistic, of a slightly older, plumper Gioachino Rossini seated at an elegant wooden table in a warm 19th-century kitchen or dining room, same facial features as his historical portrait: rounded face with faint smile, dark wavy hair, dark sideburns, wearing a dark coat with a white cravat but with a napkin tucked at the collar. He faces the viewer, delightedly writing a letter with a quill while a platter of pâté and rich delicacies sits before him, candlelight glowing, shelves of copper pots and wine bottles in the background suggesting a gourmet's world of correspondence and fine food. No text, no other people, warm golden painterly light.

middle_slides.text: 彼の名を冠した"トゥルヌドス・ロッシーニ"は今も高級レストランの定番料理。音楽史に名を残す"引退した天才"の伝説となっている。
middle_slides.image_prompt: Oil-painting style illustration, painterly, not photorealistic, of an elderly, contentedly plump Gioachino Rossini seated at a refined restaurant table, same recognizable features as his historical portrait: rounded face, gentle smile, thick dark wavy hair now slightly greying, dark sideburns, dressed in a fine dark coat with a white cravat. He faces the viewer, raising a fork toward a beautifully presented dish of tournedos Rossini (seared beef, foie gras, truffle) on a white plate before him, in an opulent 19th-century dining room with soft candlelight and rich velvet drapery, evoking the legend of the retired musical genius turned legendary gourmet. No text, warm inviting painterly atmosphere.

fb_caption:
39作目の歌劇『ウィリアム・テル』を書き上げた37歳、まだ人気絶頂だった。だが彼はそこでオペラの筆を折り、以後40年をロッシーニとして美食家人生に捧げた。✨

「忙しい大人のためのクラシック音楽ノート」では、忙しい日々の合間に、
ほんの数分だけ立ち止まりたくなる、クラシック音楽の物語を発信しています。
指揮者マエストロ・ノートが案内する、作曲家たちの知られざる人生の
ドラマ——栄光の裏にあった挫折、常識をくつがえす意外な真実——を、
毎日少しずつお届けしています。

難しい知識は必要ありません。ただ、物語として楽しんでいただければ、
それだけで十分です。

他の作曲家の逸話も知りたい方は、チャンネルもチェックしてみてください。https://youtube.com/@classicalmusic_note?si=evg6wej2KOx2uPhH
